name: Dialogue with Death
source:
Your time is up and a mysterious handsome visitor is here for you for good or for bad.

Engage in philosophical exchanges and make choices that shape your fate, exploring themes of life's purpose and relationships.

[From [url=https://elestiel.itch.io/dialogue-with-death]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的时间到了，一位神秘英俊的访客会来找你，无论好坏。

参与哲学交流并做出塑造你命运的选择，探索生命的目的和关系的主题。

[来自[url=https://elestiel.itch.io/dialogue-with-death]Itch.io[/url]]
